source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 9-10 (annual equivalent of part-period pay; a part period as its share of days, 3 of 7 = 0.4285) and p. 13; apportionment basis: wave-7 ruling 13 (monthly working days, weekly calendar days), scope ruling 19
notes: July 2026 (23 working days, Monday to Friday; 1 July is a Wednesday), employed since 1 March 2020, age 40 (no ETI). Basic R4 000 (whole month) and a recurring R2 100 standby allowance from Thursday 16 July: 12 of 23 working days, 2 100 x 12 / 23 = 1 095.652 -> 1 095.65 (ruling 13: monthly = working days, employedShareOfMonth). Gross 5 095.65; annual equivalent about R61 000, under the R95 750 threshold: PAYE R0 (G21 p. 13). UIF 1% = 50.96 each side; SDL 1% = 50.96; net 5 095.65 - 50.96 = 5 044.69. Before W29 the allowance paid in full (gross 6 100, net 6 039).
